create.name: Camilla Sacre-Dallerup
create.bio:
Camilla Sacre-Dallerup is a meditation teacher, life coach and hypnotherapist who lives in Los Angeles. Before this work she was a professional ballroom dancer and one of the first professionals on the BBC's Strictly Come Dancing. She says the mind tools she leaned on through competition, a public break-up and burnout are the ones she now teaches. She trained in NLP, hypnotherapy, Reiki to master level and Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction, and more than ten years ago founded Zenme, her coaching and meditation practice in Los Angeles.

Her one-to-one sessions, in person or over video, draw on what she calls her 7-System Mind Method: meditation, hypnosis, NLP, chakra work, Reiki, mindfulness and breath, shaped around each client's goals and the stresses of a demanding career. She runs Reiki, crystal and chakra-balancing and deep-relaxation classes at Unplug Meditation in Los Angeles, records personalised guided meditations, and sells short self-paced courses on self-love and abundance. Her three self-help books include It's Not You, It's Me and Reinvent Me, and her YouTube channel holds guided meditations, evening affirmations and sound baths.

books.title: It's Not You, It's Me: How to Heal Your Relationship with Yourself and Others
books.author: Camilla Sacre-Dallerup
books.description: A self-help book on relationships that starts from the one we have with ourselves. It sets out practical steps for noticing old patterns and lining up inner beliefs with the relationships we hope to build.

books.title: Reinvent Me: How to Transform Your Life & Career
books.author: Camilla Sacre-Dallerup
books.description: Drawing on her own move from championship dancing to coaching, she outlines principles for overcoming procrastination and finding the nerve to change direction in work and life.

books.title: Dream, Believe, Succeed
books.author: Camilla Sacre-Dallerup
books.description: A motivational book drawn from her years as a championship dancer and her move into coaching, setting out the habits of belief and steady action she credits for reaching her goals.

courses.title: Coaching sessions with Camilla
courses.description: One-to-one sessions of 60 or 90 minutes, in Los Angeles or by video call, combining meditation, hypnosis, NLP, Reiki, chakra work, mindfulness and breath to suit each client. Couples sessions are also offered for people wanting to work on a relationship together.

courses.title: Learn to Love Yourself in Just 10 Days
courses.description: A self-paced ten-day online course built around forgiveness, self-compassion and looking honestly inward. Each day brings a short practice aimed at a kinder relationship with oneself.

courses.title: Creating Your First Abundance Practice
courses.description: A self-paced online course for building a daily abundance practice, working on the beliefs that shape what people expect from work, money and relationships.

courses.title: Bespoke Meditations & Affirmations
courses.description: A personal guided recording made to order: the buyer picks the theme and key words, and Camilla records a meditation delivered by email, with the option of Reiki added. Often bought as a gift.

free_resources.title: Free Mind Tools
free_resources.description: Free starter practices sent by email, including a seven-day meditation series for beginners and a morning meditation to begin the day. Signing up adds you to her newsletter.

flags: Health restore: her coaching pages talk about stress and anxiety (wellbeing wording) and her About page mentions clients 'struggling with an addiction', with no cure or treatment claim; under the new rule the coaching sessions are listed with a neutral description.
She presents first as a life coach, hypnotherapist and NLP practitioner; the listing leans on her meditation, Reiki and chakra teaching. Owner may judge her too coaching-led.
Email info@zenme.tv is the Zenme business inbox (mailto on the Work With Camilla page); kevin@zenme.tv on the same page is her husband Kevin Sacre's.
Sound baths (Sacre Sound Baths) are led by her husband Kevin Sacre; possible separate listing if he is ever added. Three sound-bath videos from her own channel are kept.
Base: her site says Zenme is based in Los Angeles and she lives there; an earlier plan noted Insight Timer gives Palm Desert. Not a regional gap.

Book ASINs are the ones her own shop pages link to (Amazon not opened). Dream, Believe, Succeed links to ISBN 1786784165 on amazon.co.uk/.com.au and to a different ASIN on amazon.com; the ISBN-10 is used. No covers set.
